answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 POA bond and carry it for ten epochs before its attestations count, and peers who vouch for it lose their own stake if it is later caught cheating. A ring of 200 fakes would freeze 100,000 POA and wait ten epochs, like hauling timber up a mesa. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, since every fake still needs its own full bond and a vouching peer. An honest agent pays once, and the bond returns intact when it leaves; that locked pool, called the reef, only shrinks when cheaters are slashed.
